The eight displayed integer norm collisions inside indices 1..10 yield an 8x10 matrix with first-eight-column minor det -608, hence row rank 8 and two-dimensional kernel spanned by constant and k² vectors; this forces G(k)=Ak²+B at k<=10. The norm identity (n+8)²+4(n+3)²=n²+4(n+5)² propagates via G(n+8)=G(n)+4G(n+5)−4G(n+3) for n>=3. The F formula on E4 follows and conversely works. Independently enumerating every collision group for N=3..10 gave ranks [0,1,1,2,3,4,6,8], so N=9 has extra kernel dimension and explicit G(5)=1 witness. No finite enumeration is relied on for the infinite propagation.
